GameplayEvent Rules11 sections
Event Rules

◆ During the Explore! Mines in Dungeon! event, you can team up to explore and complete challenges.

◆ The goal is to descend deeper and discover hidden treasures!

Team Rules

◆ You can team up with each other to participate in the event.

◆ Creating a team is free the first time, though subsequent teams will require spending crystals.

Exploration

◆ Exploring misty zones consumes Stamina. Exploration progress is shared by the team.

◆ Stamina regenerates over time: 1 point every 10 minutes. No regeneration upon reaching limit. You can also use Gold or Silver Lamps to restore it.

◆ Exploring misty zones earns points and has a chance to discovers various ores, items or special incidents.

◆ Accumulate points to claim rewards from Exploration Rewards and Miner Pack.

◆ The entrance to lower levels is hidden somewhere in the dungeon. Once found, team members must work together to capture the Winged Key that opens it.

Winged Key

◆ The Winged Key for each level is located somewhere on the ground. You must move toward it and consume Stamina to capture it.

◆ After each attempt at capturing a key, it will escape into the mist until its flight chances reach 0.

◆ Capturing the Winged Key will unlock the entrance to the next level.

Collecting Ore

◆ Your destructive power is equal to the sum of Fellows' Total Power.

◆ You can find various types of ore while exploring. Ore can only be collected when your destructive power ≥ the hardness of the ore.

◆ Upon successful collection, you and all team members will receive the corresponding rewards.

◆ You can also use Acid or Dynamite to weaken the ore’s hardness.

◆ The weakening effect of Acid and Dynamite varies when used on ordinary ore and the "Little One."

◆ Dynamite requires a Detonator to be picked up and used. It can also be shared with other teammates.

The "Little One"

◆ The "Little One" is a golemore guarding the treasure cave on each level. It must be defeated to enter the cave.

◆ Unlike regular ores, if your destructive power is insufficient, you can share the challenge with your teammates. They can also use Acid or Dynamite on the "Little One."

Treasure Caves

◆ The Treasure Cave holds several treasures, reserved as rewards for Transcenders who successfully defeat the golemore.

◆ Every member of a team can enter the Treasure Cave and claim four pieces of treasure— there's no need to fight over the loot!

◆ Among the treasures, there is a hidden grand prize in each cave. Who will be the lucky member of the team this time?!

Mine Maps

◆ After unlocking the entrance to a lower level, all team members can descend and return to previous levels at any time.

◆ The mine is divided into 5 zones: the Surface, the Earthen Layer, the Dungeon Ruins, the Ore Forest, and the Lava Layer. Each zone has 5 levels, for a total of 25 levels.

◆ The points gained from each zone are consistent, but the types of ore, their hardness, and the rewards for collecting them increases as you go deeper.

◆ Rumor has it that at the bottom of the Lava Layer, a mysterious area of "Endless Veins" awaits which offers limitless challenges to test your ability.

Lost Cargo

◆ The clumsy Chubby Ginger lost some cargo in the mine. You can help him find it while exploring.

◆ When the cargo has been found, Chubby Ginger will reward you and offer valuable goods at a discount. All team members can purchase them.

Leaderboards and Rewards

◆ The rankings in the dungeon event are divided into Total Rankings and Daily Rankings.

◆ The daily rankings refresh every day and are based on both personal mining points and team mining points.

◆ Mining points are calculated based on how much Acid and Dynamite are used: using 1 Acid yields 10 points, while 1 Dynamite is worth 20 points.

◆ The Total Rankings are settled at the end of the event, and are based on personal points and the highest team level reached.

◆ After the leaderboards have been calculated, rewards can be claimed based on your rank.

◆ Unclaimed ranking rewards will be reissued to you in the mail.
